prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Showcase: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a split layout to highlight official adoption details beside a pet preview card.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Confirm your companion's adoption details to prepare them for your desktop."}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Compatibility Status Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen during the home waiting phase that verifies graphics compatibility and desktop overlay status.
   config: {"new_desktop_status": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Verifying Desktop Display Compatibility", "body": "Checking system settings to ensure your desktop companion renders smoothly."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_status", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_flow] Post-Setup Companion Voice and Chat Quick Start: Add interactive voice and chat instruction component on the home_intro screen explaining pet interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready to Chat!", "body": "Click your pet anytime or press Ctrl+Space to start talking and issuing desktop commands."}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Placement After Pick Friend Stage: Move sign-in after pick_friend so users select their companion before authenticating.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Selection Helper Hint: Display a helpful hint clarifying that path choices can be altered anytime after onboarding in settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can switch between preset pets and custom photo pet creation anytime in application settings."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time and Progress Estimator: Show live dynamic progress and estimated finish time on the waiting screen while background assets build.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Your companion assets are currently being synthesized and optimized for your monitor."}}
6: [sign_in, incentive] Account Cloud Sync Security Incentive Banner: Add a cloud backup verification badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in prevents pet loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet with Cloud Sync", "body": "Sign in to save your companion profile to the cloud and prevent progress resets.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Cloud Sync Protection Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, copy] Custom Photo Upload Clarity Guidance: Update upload_photos screen copy with explicit photo guidelines regarding lighting and framing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "For best generation results, upload well-lit photos facing forward with minimal background blur."}}
8: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Path Selection Redesign: Transform the choose_path screen layout into structured cards for companion selection paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Select Your Onboarding Path", "body": "Choose whether to adopt a classic companion or upload photos for a custom companion creation."}}
9: [home, notification] Background Generation Ready Desktop Notification: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is rendered.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will send a desktop notification as soon as your companion is ready to appear!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining key details is permitted inside onboarding.
Adding a compatibility verification screen during the waiting phase inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding interactive shortcut instructions to the home intro overlay is permitted as part of onboarding.
Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Adding helper hints to the path selection screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Showing dynamic progress and estimates during a real waiting period is allowed under rule 5.
Adding a cloud backup information badge to the sign-in screen is permitted.
Updating guidance copy on the photo upload screen is allowed.
Redesigning path selection into cards while preserving both adoption choices is allowed.
Enabling optional readiness notifications on the waiting screen is allowed.
